projectContext: Sprint 21 continues testing focus from Sprint 20, targeting cross-module coordination tests and CLAUDE.md rule compliance verification. Key areas: retry queue/circuit breaker deadlock prevention (Rule 27 subprocess encoding), caption-first video ID resolution (Rule 26), B-roll propagation chain (Rule 8), checkpoint stage data validation (Rule 25), config deep merge sibling preservation (Rule 23), and OTIO auto-split behavior (Rule 17). Sprint 13-20 established ~170 stories of test coverage. This sprint addresses complex integration scenarios and edge cases in the ~800 LOC of coordination logic.

userStories.title: Add retry queue and circuit breaker coordination edge case tests
userStories.notes: Added 7 tests in TestConcurrentRetryCoordination class: concurrent CB wait serialization, shared CB between queues, failure/success thread safety, state machine transitions, blocking via start_retry_pass, half-open recovery. Verified 191 total CB+retry coordination tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test RetryQueue.add_to_retry() blocks when circuit breaker is in OPEN state
Test RetryQueue.process_batch() respects circuit breaker pause duration scaling
Test concurrent retry attempts coordinate through circuit breaker state machine
Test deadlock prevention when retry queue and circuit breaker both wait on each other
Test batch retry resumes correctly after circuit breaker transitions to HALF_OPEN
